body.title: bug: Markdown preview incorrectly parses image and link URLs when Markdown files are in repo subfolders
body.body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

Yes, I've linked the repository below

### Description

The Markdown preview web interface references the wrong URL when the Markdown file is stored in a subfolder to the repository root.

Consider the following folder structure:

```
repository/
├── subfolder/
│   ├── file.md
│   └── image.jpg
├── file.md
└── image.jpg
```

In `repository/file.md`, linking to an image works correctly using relative paths. Using the same approach in `repository/subfolder/file.md` results in the Markdown preview incorrectly parsing the location of `repository/subfolder/image.jpg`. As a result, the image does not appear in the preview pane. However, the path is correct (and the image/link works) when viewing the Markdown file outside of the editor. Refer to the screenshots below.

The image/link path in the Markdown preview is presented as:

`{username}/repository/subfolder/media/branch/main/image.jpg`

But the correct path is actually:

`{username}/repository/media/branch/main/subfolder/image.jpg`

Note how `subfolder` appears after the repository name in the first URL instead of before `image.jpg`.

This does not seem to be a relative path issue in the image reference; it actually occurs based on where the Markdown file itself is stored. If the Markdown file is stored directly in the root repository, the URL is processed correctly in the Markdown preview. If the Markdown file is in a subfolder, then the URL is parsed incorrectly. In either situation, the image is being linked as `![~](image.jpg)`.

I have tested this on a self-hosted Forgejo instance, Codeberg, and the Forgejo dev demo. For comparison, Gitea works correctly in this regard.

[Here is the link](https://v18.next.forgejo.org/sky6350/repository) to the test repo on the Forgejo dev demo site. You will need to clone this to your own repo to be able to edit the file and use the Markdown preview to see the problem.

### Screenshots

**Editing the Markdown file:**

![markdown_preview](/attachments/fd02f771-1e9b-47d1-8488-09462a6a3284)

**Viewing the Markdown file:**

![markdown_viewer](/attachments/4f938f8e-e8d1-4204-b618-51255c0aa6c3)

**Excerpts from browser inspector in Markdown preview mode:**

![inspector](/attachments/1e93a50e-193a-49fd-8a55-aa1b7868aa40)

### Forgejo Version

17.0.1 (self-hosted), 18.0.0-dev-259-d191d25cb3 (Forgejo dev site)

### Browser Version

Firefox 153.5.0esr

body.title: problem: Repo not showing "Donate" info of the repo's owner
body.body:
### Does your problem still exist on the latest Forgejo version?

Unknown, I can't try it for some reason (please explain)

### About your usage of Forgejo

codeberg.org user

### Problem description

A user does have a `.profile` repo containing a `FUNDING.yml`. Example: https://codeberg.org/buhtz/

But the landing pages of the users repo's do not show a donation button. Example: https://codeberg.org/buhtz/hyperorg

I understand the technical reasons: There is no `FUNDING.yml` in the repo.

I would say the repos could display  a donation button if the repos user/owner does have funding info in its `.profile` repository. It might be the best if it would be an opt-in repo setting and not a default behavior.

### Potential workarounds

Add `FUNDING.yml` into each repo.

### Forgejo Version

codeberg.org with `17.0.0-99-322c239+gitea-1.22.0`

### Other details about your environment (software names and versions)

none

### Solutions

*Accepted solutions to address this problem will go here*

body.title: bug: WikiRaw serves Git tree objects as raw blobs (200) and renders two 500 pages when the wiki repo is missing
body.body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

Yes, I've linked the repository below

### Description

# 1
The repo `https://v18.next.forgejo.org/qiaoyue/with-doc/` has wiki.
If request `https://v18.next.forgejo.org/qiaoyue/with-doc/wiki/raw/.md`, I got 200 with file below.
```
100644 Home.md\00\E6\C7\91\F3\DD\B7\9A\02\9D\AF\A9\63\F1\65\76\96\C9\9C\14\BA
```
LLM suggested it may also affect sub-directories.
However `https://v18.next.forgejo.org/api/v1/repos/qiaoyue/with-doc/wiki/page/.md` returned  404: `{"message":"找不到目标。","url":"https://v18.next.forgejo.org/api/swagger","errors":[]}`.

# 2
The repo `https://v18.next.forgejo.org/qiaoyue/no-doc` does not have wiki.
If request `https://v18.next.forgejo.org/qiaoyue/no-doc/wiki/raw/nonexist`, I got double 500 ![Screenshot 2026-11-08 at 22-39-32 服务器内部错误 - Forgejo Demo FOR TESTING ONLY ALL DATA CAN BE WIPED OUT AT ANY TIME](/attachments/705ad52b-61fd-4dab-abee-02f2f380fa9e).
(exactly `OpenRepository, no such file or directory` and `findEntryForfile, no such file or directory` on 17.0.1. You can find this special spell "findEntryForfile" in [wiki.go](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/e2bd913f63a93ce0b20bfd311908219cc91c2654/routers/web/repo/wiki.go#L652).)
Also, `https://v18.next.forgejo.org/api/v1/repos/qiaoyue/no-doc/wiki/page/1` returned 
`{"message":"找不到目标。","url":"https://v18.next.forgejo.org/api/swagger","errors":["no such file or directory"]}`.

### Forgejo Version

_No response_

### How are you running Forgejo?

binary from `https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/releases/`, managed by systemd

### Logs

_No response_

### Database

_No response_
